text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Seeking the Pearl and I are<n>enjoying some
honeyade on our way<n>back from an outing.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Geez, this is addictive! It's so<n>soothing on the
throat!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it's full of nutrients, right? It's<n>got so much
potential...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should try mixing it in some<n>miso soup.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm not! Combining it with another<n>nutrient-dense
food would create the<n>ultimate superfood!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha! This will be sure to become an<n>indispensable
drink for pre-race<n>preparations and training
sessions!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl goes ahead and<n>tries mixing
together honeyade and<n>miso soup. We both take a
sample of<n>the result, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yuuuuck! It's like the sweetness and<n>saltiness are
battling each other for<n>dominance, and we're the
losers in<n>their fight!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It seems that simply mixing them<n>won't cut it. I'll
need a little help from<n>some machinery!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Look at this rotation speed... Yep, this<n>might just do
it! Let's take my<n>experimental drink to the spinning
teacups, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We'll use the centrifugal force of the<n>ride to
combine the honeyade and<n>miso soup on a
microscopic level!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Round and round it spins! GO, GO,<n>GOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've never be spun around sointensely in my life! After getting thisthoroughly mixed, surely it should betasty! Right? ...Right?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Disguuusting! It tastes even more<n>revolting than
when I just stirred<n>them together!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now it feels like the sweet and salty<n>flavors are
actively working together<n>to ravage my tongue!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There isn't a chance in high heaven<n>anyone could
enjoy this. We have to<n>try and find a way to make
it taste<n>better!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I could try chilling it with ice to<n>brighten the flavor...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe I could use the tannins from<n>tea leaves to
balance the flavors out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter what she tries, the mixture<n>ends up
tasting repulsive. Making a<n>tasty honeyade and
miso soup<n>concoction is proving to be quite<n>difficult.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This could be the superfood I've<n>been dreaming
of—it has the perfect<n>amount of nutritional value and
untold<n>supportive possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...The reason it doesn't taste good<n>must be down to
my inexperience.<n>I'm lacking in both technique and
expertise.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I've got no other choice but to study<n>up. If I don't
deepen my knowledge<n>on miso soup, I'll never be
able to<n>make progress.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to apprentice at a famous<n>restaurant so I
can master combining<n>miso soup and honeyade!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl appears to be at her<n>wit's end. I
stop her just before she<n>bolts off to who knows
where.
choice_data_list:
It's times like these that call for a bowl of miso
soup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right. Let's take a step<n>back and plan
our next move.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Slurp...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Delicious! It tastes nothing like<n>how it is with
honeyade added to it.
choice_data_list:
They both sure taste great when you drink them
separately, don't they?

They both sure taste great when you drink them
separately, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, they really do. When you drink<n>them on their
own, their flavors don't<n>clash at all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey... hold up! Does this mean that so<n>long as you
don't drink them<n>simultaneously, things might
actually<n>turn out okay?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even though I just had miso soup, I<n>don't feel
grossed out at all by the<n>honeyade! And yet, I'm
getting the<n>nutrients from both!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I get it now! The answer is to pair<n>them like cheese
and crackers<n>instead of forcing them together like
chocolate milk!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I was so preoccupied with creating<n>the perfect
honeyade-miso mix, I<n>completely missed the
solution that<n>was staring me in the face!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Which means... the amount of foods<n>to possibly pair
with miso soup has<n>just expanded in an instant!
Trainer,<n>we must go at once!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Look at all the wonderful foods<n>sparkling like gems!
Any one of them<n>has the possibility of going
perfectly<n>with miso soup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For example—how about that curry<n>over there?!
Pairing turmeric and miso<n>soup could improve
circulation and<n>stave off the cold!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Having some apple pie after a meal<n>would be nice,
too! You could absorb<n>all the essential vitamins
from the<n>fruit, making it the ideal combination!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined that taking a step<n>back could
broaden my horizons and<n>reveal so many
possibilities! It's all<n>thanks to you for stopping me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Let's use social media<n>to spread the
word!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Hi, everyone! How about livening up<n>your dinner
tonight with some miso<n>soup and apple pie?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Give it a try! It's the perfect pairing<n>for getting all
your essential nutrients<n>in one go!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl's post kickstarts a
#WithMisoSoup trend as people begin<n>flooding
social media with new food<n>pairing suggestions.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We certainly do! There's a treasure<n>trove of food
here. We can try<n>anything!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Vanilla ice cream might be a good<n>choice. Paired
with miso soup, it could<n>help you recover energy
when<n>you're feeling fatigued.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Avocado would be a perfect match<n>with miso soup
as it can help remove<n>excess salt from your body!
Haha,<n>there really are endless possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl becomes<n>completely absorbed in
her research,<n>trying to cover every possible
combination.
